title: PyTPS: an educational radiotherapy treatment planning system
description: PyTPS is a free, open-source radiotherapy treatment planning system for teaching medical physics students. It covers DICOM CT import, contouring, static fields and VMAT arcs, pencil-beam dose calculation, IMRT and VMAT optimisation, DVH evaluation and plan comparison, with a beam's-eye view, 3D and treatment room views and a guided VMAT-TBI exercise. It is not intended for clinical use.
